items.summary: Strange and turbulent times call for insistent new theme songs and rallying cries. items.title: M(h)aol – “Scam Manifesto”
items.summary: Irish post-punkers M(h)aol signed to Merge and released their album Something Soft last year. Since then, they've lost a member and become a trio, and now they've shared the jittery, deadpan new one-off single "Scam Manifesto." (Anyone who saw I Shot Andy Warhol will be able to appreciate the wordplay of that title.) It's about the way you can feel about yourself after too much time on the internet: "I said that I’m worth more, but I’m a liar/ I see my limbs and all I want to do is set my house on fire." Former member Sarah Deegan, now of Pixie Cut Rhythm Orchestra, joins in on backup vocals.

items.title: Radiohead Announce 2027 Shows In Australia & Japan
items.summary: Ed O'Brien was telling the truth. Back when the Radiohead guitarist announced his solo album Blue Morpho , he revealed that his longtime bandmates had developed a plan for touring going forward. In 2025, Radiohead played their first shows in seven years , a series of multi-show residencies in European cities. O'Brien explained that they'd like to keep doing that every year starting in 2027, choosing a different continent each time. Now we know where they're headed next year. Tonight, the Phoenix festival, which is scheduled for March 5 and 6, officially announced an updated 2027 lineup, and Jane Remover has been removed.
